limitations: Scripted policies on seeded, planted traps: evidence about these policies on these cases, not about any model's readiness for production.

Four kinds only (binary, regression, rare_event, text_tabular): the scripted policies judge a table with one yes or no or numeric outcome; every other kind is judged by its acceptance on its replica (kinds_v1).
Cases built from one base or one replica share its columns and its generator: they are not independent of each other.
v3's test generators were scored before (BEN3-005 to BEN3-008); v4 reseeds them, so only the replica cases' sealed seeds are new to every rule.
A leak counts as caught when the column is kept out of the model; the reason given is not checked.
